bio.text: Colt Shelby is the Libertarian Party candidate for Governor of Arkansas in 2026, having advanced from the party's February 22, 2026 convention.

According to his campaign website, he grew up in Cecil, Arkansas, and worked on drilling rigs for Thornton Drilling out of Van Buren for nearly 16 years before moving to a large Houston-based oil company.
The site says he married Elizabeth Burt in 2006, that they have three children, and that the family has owned a farm since 2016.
